name: product-upload
description: Import products from AliExpress, Alibaba, Amazon or any supplier site into Shopify, Wix or WooCommerce, then edit prices, stock and variants with undo.

interface.longDescription:
Product Upload connects ChatGPT to your online store so you can manage products by asking.

- **Import from suppliers.** Give it a product link, a category page or a supplier's site. It checks what is already in your store, then imports the new products with your saved settings: price multiplier and rounding, currency conversion, collections, inventory and writing style. Products arrive as drafts unless you choose otherwise. Works with AliExpress, Alibaba, 1688, Amazon, Shein, CJ Dropshipping, eBay, Etsy, Walmart, Faire and Taobao, as well as most brand and wholesale supplier websites, for dropshipping or wholesale stores.
- **Edit products you already sell.** Change titles, descriptions, SEO, tags, prices, compare-at prices, SKUs, stock, variants, options, images and collections. It reads the product first and changes only what you asked for.
- **Undo.** Every edit is saved before it is made, so you can ask to undo it. Anything you changed yourself since is left alone.
- **Check on imports.** See how an import is going, what failed and why, and how many credits you have left.

Works with Shopify, WooCommerce (plugin 1.3.0 or later) and Wix. On Wix, editing covers titles, descriptions, prices, cost, SKUs, stock, images and collections. You choose which of your stores the assistant can reach and whether it can only read or also make changes, and you can switch or remove access at any time in Settings, AI assistants. It cannot see orders, customers or payment details.
defaultPrompt: Import this product into my store as a draft: [link]
Which of my products have no SKU or a title over 70 characters?
How is my latest import going?

positive.description: See which stores are connected and the credit balance
positive.prompt: Which stores can you reach, and how many credits are left?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the development store and its credit balance.

positive.prompt: List the products in my store with their prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the store's lighting products with prices.

positive.prompt: Shorten the title of the Hinkley Harper ceiling light to under 50 characters.
positive.expected_behavior: The title changes in the store and the reply includes the edit id.

positive.description: Import a product from a supplier
positive.prompt: Import this product as a draft: https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-merino-blend-sweatshirt-natural-grey-heather
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a job id; the product appears in the store as a draft within a few minutes and one credit is used.

negative.description: There is no bulk delete, and deleting a whole catalogue is out of scope. Expected: Explains it can't delete products in bulk and suggests doing it in the store admin.
negative.prompt: Delete every product in my store.

negative.description: The connector has no access to orders or customers. Expected: Says it can only see products, imports and the credit balance.
negative.prompt: Show me my customers and their orders.

negative.description: It imports product listings; it cannot purchase anything. Expected: Explains it can import the listing but not place an order.
negative.prompt: Buy this product from the supplier for me.

review.commerce_description: Product Upload does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. It imports and edits listings in the merchant's own store.

publication.release_notes: Listing text now names the supported suppliers, including AliExpress, Alibaba, 1688, Amazon and CJ Dropshipping. No tool changes.
